sections.Profile:
Discomania, released by Nordamatic of Verona, Italy, in 1979, is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine from the same year the company brought out Antares, its only solid-state game.

- Manufacturer: Nordamatic
- Years made: 1979
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Dancing, Original Theme, 1970s, Music
